originalTitle: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
summary: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
content:
El Salvador's president posted a video on X of the strikes on a complex he said is the headquarters of 400 Mawozo

Haiti's Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé has praised "the commitment of the Salvadorean forces in the fight against gangs" after a joint strike on a house allegedly used by the leader of the 400 Mawozo gang.

El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele, had earlier announced that a joint task force had "destroyed" what he described as "the house of Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters".

A small contingent of Salvadorean troops has been in Haiti since January 2025 as part of a multinational force deployed to suppress gang violence.

Last month, Bukele sent an extra 2,000 soldiers to rescue four Salvadoreans who have been missing since they were ambushed on 18 October.

Bukele's post on X , external was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex.

As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes.

Writing in Creole, Bukele said "we kept our promise", adding that the alleged gang members "ran away without even trying to fight".

Local media reported that as many as 20 people were killed in the strike, which they said was carried out in the early hours of Sunday.

They also reported that Lanmò San Jou, whose real name is Wilson Joseph, was not at the property at the time of the attack.

Posting on X on Tuesday, Fils-Aimé thanked the Salvadorean military's commitment "in the fight against gangs" and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority".

"THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added.

While he did not provide any further details about the joint operation or the number of casualties, Fils-Aimé posted a still from the video shared by Bukele showing a helicopter firing a projectile at the compound.

The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the headquarters of the 400 Mawozo, Haiti's largest criminal gang, which is infamous for carrying out kidnappings for ransom.

Salvadorean troops have become a regular sight in Port-au-Prince

The attack on the alleged gang headquarters seemingly came after a user on X had urged Bukele to attack the complex.

"Where is that house? Give us the exact address, and we'll destroy it," the Salvadorean president replied to the post, which has now been taken down, apparently for violating X's rules.

Bukele has threatened Haitian gangs before.

Following the kidnapping of four Salvadorean air force technicians on 18 October, he addressed "the gang leaders and gang members holding our four compatriots hostage in Haiti" directly.

"We have already finished with the gangs in El Salvador, and we can finish with you too," he wrote in Creole, referring to his crackdown on gang violence in his own country.

The four abducted Salvadoreans were working as part of the GSF, made up of troops from several nations.

Bukele's decision to send thousands of additional troops to Haiti since their abduction has raised concerns with critics who say they are not all working within the command structure of the GSF.

It has also raised questions about the operational legitimacy and legality of their actions in the Caribbean nation.

Amnesty International has urged both countries to "ensure all operations conducted by Salvadorean forces in Haiti comply with international human rights law".

chineseTitle: 海地总理赞扬萨尔瓦多联合袭击据称帮派头目的住所
chineseSummary: 400 名 Mawozo 帮派成为萨尔瓦多军方的攻击目标，萨尔瓦多军方已部署数千名士兵来应对海地的帮派暴力危机。
chineseContent:
萨尔瓦多总统在 X 上发布了一段针对他所说的 400 Mawozo 总部大楼的袭击的视频

海地总理阿利克斯·迪迪埃·菲尔斯-艾梅在对据称 400 Mawozo 帮派头目使用的房屋进行联合袭击后赞扬了“萨尔瓦多军队打击帮派的承诺”。

萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱早些时候宣布，一支联合特遣部队“摧毁”了他所说的“兰莫·圣朱的房子和 400 Mawozo 帮派的总部”。

自 2025 年 1 月以来，一小支萨尔瓦多部队一直驻扎在海地，作为部署镇压帮派暴力的多国部队的一部分。

上个月，布克莱增派了 2,000 名士兵去营救 4 名自 10 月 18 日遭到伏击以来失踪的萨尔瓦多人。

布克莱在 X , external 上的帖子附有几架直升机向大型建筑群开火的视频。

当直升机在上空盘旋时，可以看到数十人逃离家园，逃离空袭。

布克莱用克里奥尔语写道，“我们遵守了诺言”，并补充说，被指控的帮派成员“甚至没有试图战斗就逃跑了”。

当地媒体报道称，罢工是在周日凌晨进行的，造成多达 20 人死亡。

他们还报告说，兰莫·圣朱（Lanmò San Jou）的真名是威尔逊·约瑟夫（Wilson Joseph），袭击发生时并不在酒店内。

菲尔斯-艾梅周二在 X 上发帖，感谢萨尔瓦多军方“打击帮派”的承诺，并表示两国将继续与联合国支持的镇压帮派部队（GSF）合作，“重新控制领土并恢复国家权威”。

“这些帮派将无法入睡！”他补充道。

虽然菲尔斯-艾梅没有提供有关联合行动或伤亡人数的更多细节，但菲尔斯·艾梅发布了布克莱分享的视频中的一张剧照，显示一架直升机向该院落发射射弹。

BBC 无法核实 Bukele 发布的视频，也无法核实该房产是否确实是海地最大犯罪团伙 400 Mawozo 的总部，该团伙因实施绑架勒索赎金而臭名昭著。

萨尔瓦多军队已成为太子港的常客

对所谓的帮派总部的攻击似乎是在 X 上的一名用户敦促布克莱攻击该建筑群之后发生的。

萨尔瓦多总统在回复该帖子时说：“那栋房子在哪里？给我们确切的地址，我们会毁掉它。”该帖子现已被删除，显然是因为违反了 X 的规则。

布克莱此前曾威胁过海地帮派。

10 月 18 日，四名萨尔瓦多空军技术人员被绑架后，他直接向“在海地扣押我们四名同胞的帮派头目和帮派成员”发表讲话。

他用克里奥尔语写道：“我们已经结束了萨尔瓦多的帮派活动，我们也可以结束你们的活动。”他指的是他在自己国家打击帮派暴力的行为。

四名被绑架的萨尔瓦多人是 GSF 的一部分，该部队由来自多个国家的部队组成。

自被绑架以来，布克莱决定向海地增派数千名士兵，这引起了批评者的担忧，他们称他们并不都在海地安全部队的指挥结构内工作。

它还对他们在加勒比国家的行动的合法性和合法性提出了质疑。

国际特赦组织敦促两国“确保萨尔瓦多军队在海地开展的所有行动均遵守国际人权法”。
